cohort: The study included 47 twin deliveries from a rural tertiary healthcare center in India, specifically focusing on the second twin.
finding: Second twin deliveries in rural tertiary care settings are associated with significant perinatal risks, particularly low birth weight and the need for Special Newborn Care Unit (SNCU) admission.
mod_finding: A higher rate of cesarean deliveries (70.2%) was observed for the second twin, reflecting clinical caution in their management.
birth_weight: Average birth weight of the second twin was 1.94 kg, with 34% of cases having low birth weight.
